oas/info/description:
aiServeWeaveGateway exposes two groups of HTTP APIs:

- **Public inference frontend** (default listen address; requires a tenant API Key): OpenAI-compatible chat/embeddings/responses/models, plus workflow Job submission, status, SSE events, cancellation, and artifact downloads.
- **Read-only operations API** (mounted only when `-admin-addr` is configured separately; uses a deployment secret rather than a tenant Key): fleet inventory, workflow catalog, per-tenant job lists, and effective routing status for aggregation by the control plane. It performs no writes.

Source: `service/aiServeWeaveGateway/httpapi/` (public frontend) and `service/aiServeWeaveGateway/adminapi/` (operations API).
oas/servers/0/description: Public inference endpoint (default port; configurable with -addr)
oas/servers/1/description: Read-only operations API (configured separately with -admin-addr; disabled if unset)
oas/tags/3/description: OpenAI-compatible Responses (converted to canonical chat requests)
oas/tags/4/description: Workflow Job submission, status, events, cancellation, and artifacts
oas/tags/5/description: Read-only operations API (fleet inventory, workflow catalog, and per-tenant job lists), authenticated with a deployment secret
oas/paths/~1v1~1models/get/summary: List models for which at least one connected node currently declares chat support
oas/paths/~1v1~1chat~1completions/post/r:
Non-streaming: a complete ChatCompletionResponse.
Streaming (stream=true): `text/event-stream`, with `data: <ChatCompletionChunk>` frames, ending with `data: [DONE]`.
Sequence of SSE frames, each containing a ChatCompletionChunk as JSON
oas/paths/~1v1~1responses/post/summary: OpenAI-compatible Responses (converted to canonical chat requests at the boundary)
oas/paths/~1v1~1responses/post/descripti: Only stateless, one-shot generation is supported. `previous_response_id`, `store=true`, and `background=true` are rejected (400): this Gateway neither retains stored sessions nor runs background jobs. Built-in tools such as web_search and non-function tools are also rejected.
oas/paths/~1v1~1responses/post/responses: Non-streaming: a complete Response object. Streaming (stream=true): `text/event-stream`.
oas/paths/~1v1~1workflows~1{workflow_id}:
The body contains only input values declared by the template. The graph comes from a server-registered template; callers cannot submit arbitrary graphs.

Without file inputs (`type: file`), use `application/json`, limited to 1 MiB. With file inputs (P04 in STATUS.md), use `multipart/form-data`: the `inputs` field contains the same body as the JSON form; each other field is named after a declared file input and contains its bytes. The entire request is limited to 200 MiB. The node selected by Gateway receives the bytes and writes them to its local ComfyUI input directory. File submissions are therefore pinned to one candidate node without cross-node retries: dispatch failure on that node fails the whole request, without reuploading to another node.
The same request body as application/json, encoded as a JSON string in this form field
Each form field is named after a declared file input and contains the file's bytes
Accepted; returns the newly created job (usually queued)
The workflow template is not registered, or no node can run workflows
oas/paths/~1v1~1jobs~1{job_id}/get/summa: Query the status of a run
oas/paths/~1v1~1jobs~1{job_id}/get/descr: Finished runs are answered directly from this Gateway's in-memory job table. Active runs query their execution node, using the backend queue and history for status.
oas/paths/~1v1~1jobs~1{job_id}~1events/g: Subscribe to a run's event stream (SSE)

Finished runs immediately return a single terminal-state frame instead of a subscription. The event name (SSE `event:` field) is the backend event type, such as progress, node_output, succeeded, failed, or cancelled; the payload is JobEvent.
oas/paths/~1v1~1jobs~1{job_id}~1cancel/p: Cancellation is an asynchronous request, not a final result. This endpoint returns 202 and the last known job view; the status endpoint or event stream reports the outcome. Finished jobs return 409; nodes without interruption support return 501.
The job has finished and cannot be cancelled
The node running this job does not support interruption
oas/paths/~1v1~1jobs~1{job_id}~1artifact: List artifacts produced by a run

Public artifact_id values are minted here. The backend locates files by the filename/subfolder/type tuple, which is never exposed as an identifier. Repeated listings for the same job return the same id.
oas/paths/~1v1~1artifacts~1{artifact_id}: The response body is forwarded directly, streamed from the tunnel without ever buffering it in full in the Gateway process.
Artifact content (Content-Type and Content-Disposition depend on the backend)
oas/paths/~1internal~1v1~1routes/get/sum: Routing revision actually applied by this replica and its latest synchronization status
oas/paths/~1internal~1v1~1routes/get/des: Available only on the operations listener. File mode does not confirm a control-plane revision. Errors use fixed codes without configuration or credentials.
oas/paths/~1internal~1v1~1nodes/get/summ: Fleet inventory currently observed by this replica
oas/paths/~1internal~1v1~1workflows/get/: Workflow template catalog registered on this replica (route absent if no template directory is configured)
oas/paths/~1internal~1v1~1jobs/get/summa: Runs for one tenant on this replica (route absent when the public frontend is disabled)
oas/paths/~1internal~1v1~1jobs/get/descr: tenant_id is required; omitting it returns 400 rather than runs for all tenants.
oas/paths/~1internal~1v1~1jobs/get/respo: This tenant's runs on this replica
oas/components/securitySchemes/bearerAut: Tenant API Key (Authorization: Bearer <key>). Deployments with no authentication configured allow all requests.
oas/components/securitySchemes/adminToke: Deployment-level operations secret (AISW_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN), independent of tenant API Keys.
oas/components/schemas/ChatCompletionReq: A string or an array of strings
A string (auto/none/required) or an object naming one tool
oas/components/schemas/EmbeddingsRequest: A string or an array of strings
oas/components/schemas/ResponsesRequest/: A string or an array of input items, each with role and content
A string or an object naming one tool
oas/components/schemas/RunRequest/proper: Declared template input names mapped to values (unmodified JSON)
oas/components/schemas/JobEvent/properti: Raw backend payload, varying by event type
oas/components/schemas/Replica/propertie: Backends discovered on this Gateway's loopback interface; inventory only.
oas/components/schemas/Node/properties/i: Slot class (inference/bulk) mapped to idle counts
